svg.aria-label: Planning (1 day): Tickets assigned, velocity committed. Implementation (3 days): All tickets DONE or NOT_DONE, blockers resolved. Done (0.5 day): Retro findings recorded, QA verified. Rest (0.5 day): Automatic after retro. Order: Planning -> implementation -> done -> rest. Each phase has a gate check. Configurable: Change phases, durations and gates with update_sprint_config. QA gate (since 2.2): qa_verified needs commits with Why:/What:/How: body groups. Open-items gate (since 2.0): start_sprint and advance_sprint refuse while untriaged retro try_next findings or escalated discoveries exist. Override with acknowledge_open_items: true
